profile.headline: Senior Developer/SDET/Tech Lead
profile.summary: QA Automation Engineer with a focus on RobotFramework, Selenium, and Python.  Additional experience with Locust and Mamba, as well as Java, Javascript, and a variety of other tools and languages.  Primarily interested in SDET Lead/Sr SDET positions.

positions.title: QA Automation Lead
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Lead a team of five offshore workers.  Automated and improved processes around projects and communications.  Reduced team manual and bureaucratic workload by 70%, allowing them to focus on automation.  Got to 99% automation coverage on all code within a week of code submission.  Reduced script issues by 90%, and ensured all script related issues were fixed within 2 business days.  Restored team trust in automated tests.  Heavily increased responsiveness of QA team to stakeholders, taking response time from days down to seconds.
